## MAGICCv7.5.3 AR6
```{r 07_climate/MAGICC7 AR6}
magiccvar <- c("Effective Radiative Forcing|Basket|Anthropogenic",
               "Surface Temperature (GSAT)",
               "Atmospheric Concentrations|CO2")

for (mv in magiccvar) {
  fullvar <- paste0("MAGICC7 AR6|", mv, "|50.0th Percentile")
  if (fullvar %in% levels(data$variable)) {
    showLinePlots(data, fullvar) # plots 50th percentile
    showLinePlots(data, paste0("MAGICC7 AR6|", mv, "|67.0th Percentile"))
    print(plotPercentiles(data, variables = paste0("MAGICC7 AR6|", mv)))
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

## Internal parameterization vs. MAGICC7 AR6 600-member ensemble
```{r 07_climate/internal_vs_magicc}
percentiles <- c(5, 10, 33, 50, 67, 90, 95)
percentileVars <- paste0("MAGICC7 AR6|Surface Temperature (GSAT)|", sprintf("%.1fth", percentiles), " Percentile")
mainVar <- "Temperature|Global Mean"

# Observed warming relative to 1850-1900 (low/high = very likely range)
references <- tribble(
  ~label,                           ~start, ~end, ~value, ~low, ~high,
  "HADCRU4 SR1.5 ref. (2006-2015)",      2006, 2015,   0.97,   NA,    NA,
  "Forster et al. 2025 (2015-2024)",      2015, 2024,   1.24, 1.11,  1.35
)

# GAMS switches of one scenario as a named character vector
getCfgGms <- function(scen) {
  id <- fileReference$fileid[fileReference$newScenarioName == scen]
  cfgGms |> filter(fileid == id) |> select(name, value) |> mutate(value = as.character(value)) |> deframe()
}


plotTemperature <- function(scen) {
  scenData <- data |> filter(scenario == scen, region == "World")
  scenColor <- scenarioColors[[match(scen, fileReference$newScenarioName)]]

  internal <- scenData |> filter(variable == mainVar)
  magicc <- scenData |>
    filter(variable %in% percentileVars) |>
    mutate(label = str_extract(variable, "[0-9.]+th"))

  lastYear <- max(magicc$period)

  ggplot(mapping = aes(period, value)) +
    geom_line(data = magicc, aes(group = variable), colour = "grey60") +
    geom_line(data = internal, colour = scenColor, linewidth = 1.2) +
    # observational references: range as a box, central value as a segment, label in the space on the right
    geom_rect(data = filter(references, !is.na(low)), aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = low, ymax = high),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "forestgreen", alpha = 0.25) +
    geom_segment(data = references, aes(x = end, xend = lastYear, y = value, yend = value),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "forestgreen", linetype = "dotted", alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_segment(data = references, aes(x = start, xend = end, y = value, yend = value),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "forestgreen", linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_text(data = references, aes(x = lastYear + 1, y = value, label = label),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "forestgreen", size = 3, hjust = 0) +
    geom_text(data = filter(magicc, period == lastYear), aes(label = sprintf("%s: %.1f K", label, value)),
              colour = "grey40", size = 3, hjust = 0, nudge_x = 1) +
    annotate("text", x = max(internal$period) + 1, y = last(internal$value),
             label = sprintf("Internal par.: %.1f K", last(internal$value)),
             colour = scenColor, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", hjust = 0) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(2020, 2100, 20), minor_breaks = seq(2010, 2100, 10),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.4))) + # room on the right for labels
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 10, 0.5), minor_breaks = seq(0, 10, 0.1)) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    labs(title = scen, x = NULL, y = "Global mean temperature (K)") +
    theme_minimal()
}


for (s in fileReference$newScenarioName) {
  print(plotTemperature(s))
  print(paste0("climate module realization: ", getCfgGms(s)["climate"]))
  print(paste0("cm_magicc_calibrateTemperature2000: ", getCfgGms(s)["cm_magicc_calibrateTemperature2000"]))
}
```
